description_en: Queries the current active sessions and their sources in a specified agent instance by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定智能体实例中的当前活动会话及其来源
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-sandbox-sessions --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --sandbox-id sbx-2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSandboxSessions

parameters.help_en: The sandbox ID. You can query the sandbox ID by calling ListSandboxes
parameters.help_zh: Sandbox ID，可通过 ListSandboxes 查询
parameters.name: sandbox_id

parameters.help_en: Must be consistent with the ListSandboxes input parameters used to retrieve the sandboxId. If omitted or left blank, the latest running unit of the agent is queried. If specified, the service endpoint must belong to the agent and the target type must be AGENT_VERSION. Otherwise, Resource.NotFound is returned. If it is not DEFAULT and is not running independently, ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady is returned. If the sandboxId does not belong to the specified running unit, Sandbox.NotFound is returned instead of an empty list
parameters.help_zh: 必须与查出该 sandboxId 时使用的 ListSandboxes 入参一致。省略或传空白时查询智能体 latest 运行单元；传入时该服务端点必须属于本智能体且目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION，否则返回 Resource.NotFound；非 DEFAULT 且未独立运行时返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady。sandboxId 不属于所指运行单元时返回 Sandbox.NotFound，不返回空列表
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值为 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. Omit this parameter in the first request. For subsequent requests, use the returned token as is and keep the workspace, agent, instance, and maxResults unchanged. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 下一页令牌。首次省略，后续原样使用响应值，并保持工作空间、智能体、实例和 maxResults 不变；为空表示没有下一页
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value is 200 if the request is successful

items.description_en: The list of active sessions for the sandbox
items.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 的活动 Session 列表

channelType.description_en: The external channel type, such as DINGTALK, FEISHU, or WECOM. This parameter is empty for non-external channels
channelType.description_zh: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空
channelType.title_en: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空
channelType.title_zh: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空

sessionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the active session
sessionId.description_zh: 活动 Session 的唯一标识

sourceType.description_en: The source type of the session. A value of API indicates an API call, CONSOLE_DEBUG indicates console debugging, EXTERNAL_CHANNEL indicates an external channel, and UNKNOWN indicates an unknown source
sourceType.description_zh: Session 来源类型。API 表示 API 调用，CONSOLE_DEBUG 表示控制台调试，EXTERNAL_CHANNEL 表示外部渠道，UNKNOWN 表示来源未知

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌；为空表示没有更多结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合本次查询条件的记录总数
